title: perf(console): opening a record re-reads no list, asks its field access once, and the bell polls once a minute
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：打开/关闭记录不再重取列表（冷：抽屉在 scope 旁读全量注册表、不再用骨架屏顶掉列表；热：列表页按值持有 `columns`/`searchableFields`）；同一记录的 field-access 并发 4 次合为 1 次；铃铛与审批角标前台轮询改为 60 s，并留好"推送通道打开即停轮询"的接缝。
- 为什么改：#27626 实测每次打开、关闭记录都多一次列表查询，冷打开还多一次计数探测；field-access 同一毫秒 4 次；铃铛 10 s 一次。
- 风险与回滚：仅 ui 两个包，无协议/元数据变更；冷打开时抽屉的关联列表在全量注册表落地前只看到 scope 内对象（落地后补齐）；新消息最多晚约 60 s 出现。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`（抽屉读注册表的位置）与 `appObjectScope.ts`，再看 `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `getRecordFieldAccess`。
- 两分钟验证：app-crm 列表页打开一条记录再关闭，Network 里没有 `top=50` 的列表请求、`field-access` 只有 1 次；页面静置 2 分钟，`sys_inbox_message` 只有 2 次。
- 需要你做的：无（draft，席位审核通过后再请你审；#27626 的 Acceptance 3 由 epic 席位在 console 预览复测）。

Fixes #27626

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**1. Opening or closing a record re-reads no list** (Target 1)

- `console/appObjectScope.ts` — the record drawer (`?recordId=`) no longer turns the route's object scope off. Only the record form overlay (`?form=`, `?formObject=`) still does, as before.
- `console/AppContent.tsx` — under a drawer, the whole registry is read beside the route's scope (`useLazyMetadataSettled('object', …)`), the route slot never waits on it, and once it has landed it joins the scope (`joinRegistryToScope`): the scope's documents first, by identity, then the registry objects the scope does not hold. The drawer's related lists still see every object, as the seat ruled. `ObjectView.tsx` is untouched.
- `views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` — `columns` and `searchableFields` go through the page's existing `holdBlock` (objectui#10046's value hold), because `ListView` names both by identity in its fetch effect (objectui#4567 put the stabilisation at the producer). This covers any host that hands the page new documents of equal content.

**2. One field-access request per record** (Target 2)

- `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` — `getRecordFieldAccess` shares one in-flight request per `object::id` (the adapter's existing `shareInFlight`), remembers a 404 as "no answer" for that record until a write to its object, and stops asking a server that answers 501. A settled projection is not cached: the next ask after a save reaches the server. A write to the object (`emitMutation` → `dropInflightReads`) drops both the shared ask and the remembered 404.

**3. The bell polls once a minute, and not at all while a push channel is open** (Target 4, seat ruling B)

- `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` — `INBOX_POLL_MS` 10 s → 60 s, `APPROVALS_POLL_MS` 30 s → 60 s. The hidden-tab stop and the retire/probe logic are unchanged. A package-internal seam, `setUserFeedPushChannelOpen(open)` / `notifyUserFeedPushed(feed)`: while a channel is open the two feeds arm no poll and read only on a push; when it closes they read once and resume the 60 s fallback. Nothing reports a channel today (see Acceptance notes), so the fallback is what runs.

**Not changed**

- `security/explain` ×2 on a record open are `update` and `delete`: two different questions, each already shared in flight and cached per (record, operation, principal) by `useRecordEditable` (objectui#11699, `useRecordEditable.inflightShare-11699.test.tsx`).
- Child metadata (Target 3): each related object's `meta/object/<name>` is read once, on the first open (0 on the warm open, below). The repeat the card measured on the cold path came from the remount in 1.
- No metadata key, nothing under `packages/spec/**` (Target 5).

## Why

Two root causes for the list re-read, measured with request logging and render tracing in the console:

- **Cold (the first open of a session):** `?recordId=` made `readAppObjectScope` treat the route as a non-scope route, so `AppContent` switched from the app's object scope to the whole registry. The registry had not been read yet, so `routeReadsSettled` went false and `RouteMetadataSkeleton` replaced `<Routes>`: the list unmounted, mounted again when the registry landed, and its mount fetch re-read the rows (`top=50`) and the count (`top=0`).
- **Warm (every later open, and every close):** no skeleton, but opening switched `allObjects` from the scope's documents to the registry's, and closing switched back. The documents have equal content but different identity, so the page rebuilt `schema.columns`, and `ListView`'s fetch effect re-ran into an identical `find`.

field-access ×4: `record:details` and `record:highlights` each mount a `RecordFieldAccessScope`, and the drawer's form and the page host ask too; all four reach `getRecordFieldAccess` in the same tick, which had no in-flight sharing (unlike `findOne`).

## Tests

- `views/ObjectView.objectDocSwapNoRefetch-27626.test.tsx` (new, real `ObjectView` / `plugin-view` / `ListView`): opening and closing records while the documents swap each time → 1 list query in total; a content-equal swap → 0; CONTROL: a real column change still refetches.
- `console/__tests__/AppContent.recordDrawerKeepsScope-27626.test.tsx` (new, real `MetadataProvider` + `AppContent`, whole-registry read held open): cold open keeps the list on its scope with no skeleton and no remount, the registry is read and joins once it lands, one document for the list's object before/during/after; warm open asks the registry no more; a deep link to a drawer draws the list before the registry lands; CONTROL: `?form=` still reads the whole registry and no scope.
- `data-objectstack/src/getRecordFieldAccess.inflightShare-27626.test.ts` (new, real adapter and client over a held transport): 4 concurrent asks → 1 request; other records are other questions; a settled answer is not remembered; a 404 is remembered per record; a 501 stops all asks; a write drops both.
- `hooks/__tests__/sharedUserFeeds.pushChannel-27626.test.tsx` (new): no channel → read at mount then once per 60 s, never sooner; channel open → 0 polls over 10 minutes and a push reads only its feed; channel open at mount; channel closing → one read then 60 s; returning to the tab with the channel open reads nothing; a push with no consumer reads nothing.
- Updated, each restating the changed behaviour: `appObjectScope-12811` (the drawer now prefetches the list's scope; the form-overlay CONTROL keeps "asks nothing"), `AppContent.objectScope-12811` (the overlay CONTROL waits for the registry to join rather than for the first paint), `sharedInboxFeed.cadence-7249`, `sharedUserFeeds.hiddenStop-12439` and `sharedInboxFeed.transient404` (restated cadence: 60 s; the revival case now tells a live feed from one on probes by the probe budget, since both cadences are 60 s).
- Reverse runs: with the `holdBlock` lines reverted the doc-swap cases read 5 and 3 list queries (asserted 1 and 1), CONTROL green; with the `AppContent` / `appObjectScope` change reverted the three drawer cases and the prefetch case fail (skeleton up, route element mounted twice, no scope asked), CONTROLs green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on `examples/app-crm`, not HotCRM** (deviation, accepted by the seat): HotCRM is not in this repo's tree; app-crm is the in-repo CRM with the same list → record drawer path. Local dev server (`objectstack dev` + console Vite), so absolute times are dev-mode times; the counts are what this card fixes.
- **Push channel:** there is none to subscribe to. `page.on('websocket')` over every measured page saw only the Vite dev server's HMR socket (`ws://localhost:<vite-port>/?token=…`, 1–2 per page load), and discovery reports `capabilities.websockets.enabled = false` and `services.realtime = false`; `service-realtime`'s in-memory adapter serves no channel route. Realtime stays out of the open core per the 2026-09-04 ruling (A), so per the seat's ruling B this PR keeps polling as the fallback at 60 s with the hidden-tab stop, and ships the "socket open → no polling" seam pinned by tests for a host that has a channel. Consequence: **a new inbox message or approval can show up to about 60 s later than before (10 s / 30 s).**
- **Cold-open drawer:** before the registry lands, the drawer's related lists are derived from the scope's objects (the app's package plus lookup targets); objects outside it join when the registry lands. On app-crm the related objects measured here are all in the app's package, so nothing visibly changes; the related reads start at about the same time as before (≈1.0–1.2 s after the click, below).
- Acceptance 3 (re-measure in the console preview) is the epic seat's, after this PR is green.

## Verification

Same script for both columns (Playwright, signed in as the seeded admin): open the first record's primary link from the list, wait 7 s (`cold`), Escape and wait 4 s (`close1`), open the second record (`warm`), Escape (`close2`). Every `/api/` request logged. `before` = the sources at the merge base `9ae6384e`, `after` = this branch.

| phase | contact before | contact after | account before | account after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cold open — total requests | 17 | 11 | 26 | 20 |
| ↳ list `top=50` / count `top=0` | 1 / 1 | 0 / 0 | 1 / 1 | 0 / 0 |
| ↳ `field-access` | 4 | 1 | 4 | 1 |
| ↳ `security/explain` (update + delete) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| ↳ `meta/object/<child>` | 1 | 1 | 4 | 4 |
| close — total (all list) | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| warm open — total | 12 | 7 | 15 | 10 |
| ↳ list `top=50` / `field-access` | 1 / 4 | 0 / 1 | 1 / 4 | 0 / 1 |
| ↳ `meta/object/<child>` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| close — total (all list) | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| URLs sent twice in one phase | field-access ×4 | none | field-access ×4 | none |
